name: duopore-public-supplied-offer-comparison
description: Compare the pay and benefits in job offers so you can see the differences clearly.

interface.longDescription: Compare the pay and benefits in job offers so you can see the differences clearly. Enter salary, guaranteed cash, any bonus plans and your own value for other benefits. Keep one-time, recurring and uncertain amounts apart, in one currency. For adults comparing their own offers. It does not work out tax, choose an offer or tell you to accept one.
defaultPrompt: Compare the pay and benefits in these job offers.
Keep guaranteed pay separate from possible bonuses.

positive.prompt: Use Supplied Offer Comparison with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
